---
title: "Setup"
---

This site embeds a Gradio app hosted on Hugging Face Spaces.

The app stores saved drafts in a mounted Hugging Face Storage Bucket at `/data`.
When run locally, it falls back to `space/data/history.json`.

Useful commands:

```bash
uv run python space/app.py
quarto render
quarto publish gh-pages --no-browser
```
